elements.prompt:
Build a screen time ring card like Opal's.
- Card 366 x 456 pt, 16 pt padding, 24 pt corners, gradient #232528 to #050506, with a soft grey light band from the left.
- Ring 294.6 pt wide: 29.3 pt band, track #19191B, inner disk #09090B, 1 pt #303033 hairline at r 109 pt.
- Arc: conic gradient clockwise from 12 o'clock, fading in to #819DC4, then #A4D3FF, #9FF8FE and #8ED6E2 at a round cap.
- Center: 1h 23m in Inter Medium 53.5 pt #FFFFFF; LESS THAN USUAL in Inter Medium 14 pt, 0.05em tracking, #8F8F8F.
- 9 thin streaks (1.5 pt) radiate outside the ring.
- Rows 41 pt apart: Usually, 4h 04m a day (Inter Semibold 24 pt, #AEB1B5, #C6C9CE); This week, 2h 41m a day (Inter Bold, #B0B6BE, #9EE5F6).
- Data rule: center = usual minus this week.
- On load, sweep the arc for 1.2 s while the number counts up.
Swap in my brand colors and font; keep the sizes.

elements.name: Unblock limit card
elements.why: The card reads as a rule, lock to shield, 10 Unblock Daily, and the pill shows 7 left before the first tap.
elements.html:

10 Unblock Daily
For
A
B
C
elements.prompt:
Build an unblock limit card like Opal's.
- Card 166 x 188 pt, 33 pt continuous corners, on a #9EC2D2 screen.
- Glass: gradient #8AB9CD to #728F9D to #697A8A, darker at the right (#627A88), 1 pt rim of white at 18%.
- Icons at 20 pt padding, 12 pt apart: lock 18 x 25 pt, arrow 18 x 15 pt (2.8 pt stroke), shield 23 x 28 pt. Gradient #A6CBFF to #A0F0FE.
- Pill at y 92 pt: 44 x 24 pt capsule, 1 pt rim #8499AA, lighter 17 pt left segment (#8296A8) behind the count. Text: Inter Semibold 12 pt #FFFFFF.
- Title: 10 Unblock Daily, Inter Semibold 15 pt, #FFFFFF, baseline 144 pt.
- Last row: For (Inter Regular 12 pt, #C3CEDA) and three overlapping 15.3 pt tiles, 3.5 pt corners: white at 30%, white initials.
- Data rule: 7 left = limit 10 minus 3 used.
- Pressed: scale the card to 0.97.
Swap in my brand colors and font; keep the sizes.

elements.prompt:
Build focus timer controls like Opal's.
- 302 x 151 pt: 3 centered rows 14 pt apart on a dark scene (#121214).
- Stepper: 37.3 pt circles beside a 140 x 51 pt value capsule, 10.7 pt gaps; glass #0F1012, 1 pt rims #454545.
- 30m: Inter Semibold 22.5 pt #FFFFFF. Minus and plus: 14 pt, 2 pt round strokes, #D0D0D0.
- Start Timer capsule 302 x 42.3 pt: gradient #2C3034 to #4C5864 to #8AA8C4, glow #80A4BE at the bottom center, rim #797A7C to #CDEFF8.
- White play triangle 8.7 x 10 pt, 9 pt gap, label Inter Semibold 13.5 pt.
- Chip 130 x 30 pt, #2A2C2D, rim #58595C: #A5E1FD shield-lock 9 x 10.7 pt, Block Apps (Inter Semibold 13.5 pt), No (Inter Regular #ADADAE).
- Blur the scene 20 pt behind each glass control.
- States: minus disables at the minimum; pressed Start Timer scales to 0.98 and glows brighter; a chip tap toggles No to Yes.
Swap in my brand colors and font; keep the sizes.
